summary: Iteration 48: Backend API Testing Complete - All 13 tests passed. Tested NEW endpoints: /api/onboarding/status, outdoor location verification on mark-sent, and trainer profile avatarUrl (profile photo). All Zelle payment system endpoints verified working correctly.

frontend_issues.note: Frontend testing skipped as requested - React Native/Expo app

GET /api/onboarding/status.description: Returns onboarding completion status - trainer needs Zelle info, trainee needs address. Returns {complete: bool, pendingSteps: [{step, label, route}]}

POST /api/payments/zelle/mark-sent.description: Correctly REJECTS Zelle mark-sent for outdoor sessions without location agreement (outdoorLocationStatus != 'agreed'). Returns 400 with message about outdoor location requirement.

GET /api/settings/zelle.description: Public endpoint returns platform Zelle info (ashtonbundy1@gmail.com / 240-281-0462)

PUT /api/admin/settings/zelle.description: Admin can update Zelle settings, non-admin blocked (403)

POST /api/trainer/zelle-info.description: Trainer saves Zelle email/phone for receiving payouts

GET /api/trainer/zelle-info.description: Trainer retrieves their Zelle info with hasZelleInfo flag

POST /api/admin/payments/verify-zelle/{s.description: Admin verifies Zelle payment, session status updated. Returns 404 for non-existent sessions.

GET /api/admin/payments/pending-zelle.description: Admin sees pending Zelle payments with trainee info. Returns {pendingPayments: [], count: 0}

GET /api/admin/payouts/pending.description: Shows trainers with Zelle info, pending balances, $35 minimum

POST /api/trainer-profiles.description: Trainer can save avatarUrl (profile photo) field when creating/updating profile

GET /api/trainer-profiles/{user_id}.description: Returns trainer profile with avatarUrl field

critical_code_review_comments: All 11 requested endpoints are working correctly
Outdoor location verification correctly blocks Zelle mark-sent when outdoorLocationStatus != 'agreed'
Onboarding status endpoint correctly checks trainer Zelle info and trainee address
Trainer profile avatarUrl field is properly saved and retrieved
Proper authorization checks in place (admin-only endpoints return 403 for non-admins)
